models.why: A 24B MoE with ~2B active that decodes 184 tok/s on an M5 Max and 114 tok/s on a Ryzen AI Max+ 395, scoring 93.4% on the Agon composite (first of 23 models) with a 14.5GB Q4_K_M that fits an 8GB card once experts are offloaded — and it was post-trained with agentic RL inside Hermes Agent, the harness the benchmark runs.
